#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MONGO (provided by FerretDB in this demo)
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These `KOBO_MONGO_` settings only affect the mongo container itself and the
# `wait_for_mongo.bash` init script that runs within the kpi and kobocat
# containers. To control what KPI/KoboCAT connect to, see `MONGO_DB_URL`.
KOBO_MONGO_PORT=27017
KOBO_MONGO_HOST=mongo.kobo.private

# The `MONGO_INITDB_*` and `KOBO_MONGO_USERNAME`/`KOBO_MONGO_PASSWORD` variables
# used by the upstream `mongo` image are deliberately absent: FerretDB does not
# run MongoDB's `docker-entrypoint-initdb.d` scripts, and it takes its
# credentials from the PostgreSQL role in its backing `postgres_ferretdb`
# container instead. See `docker-compose.backend.yml`.
MONGO_DB_NAME=formhub
MONGO_DB_URL=mongodb://ferret:badger@mongo.kobo.private:27017/formhub

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# POSTGRES
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# These `KOBO_POSTGRES_` settings only affect the postgres container itself and the
# `wait_for_postgres.bash` init script that runs within the kpi and kobocat
# containers. To control Django database connections, please see the
# `DATABASE_URL` environment variable.
POSTGRES_PORT=5432
POSTGRES_HOST=postgres.kobo.private
POSTGRES_USER=kobo
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=hedgehog
KC_POSTGRES_DB=kobocat
KPI_POSTGRES_DB=koboform

# Postgres database used by kpi and kobocat Django apps
KC_DATABASE_URL=postgis://kobo:hedgehog@postgres.kobo.private:5432/kobocat
KPI_DATABASE_URL=postgis://kobo:hedgehog@postgres.kobo.private:5432/koboform
DATABASE_URL=postgis://kobo:hedgehog@postgres.kobo.private:5432/koboform

#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REDIS
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

REDIS_PASSWORD=squirrel
REDIS_SESSION_URL=redis://:squirrel@redis-cache.kobo.private:6380/2
CACHE_URL=redis://:squirrel@redis-cache.kobo.private:6380/5
# In bytes, uncomment to cap Redis Cache memory
REDIS_CACHE_MAX_MEMORY=
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_BACKEND_URL=redis://:squirrel@redis-cache.kobo.private:6380/6
ENKETO_REDIS_MAIN_URL=redis://:squirrel@redis-main.kobo.private:6379/0
